description: Erection of a timber garden summerhouse to rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Unreferenced Landscape Plan; Unreferenced Proposed Block Plan; CH3219-1; CH3219-2  Received:  28 March 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used as a summerhouse incidental to the use of 28 Ridgeway Road, TW7 5LA as a single family hose or other purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
